verdict.rationale: Vonage documents that its Media Router "supports the scalable video feature", which improves video quality in multiparty sessions and is the product's own layered/simulcast capability. The evidence never explains how layers are encoded or that the router picks a layer per subscriber based on that subscriber's bandwidth. missing for 10: explicit documentation of simulcast/SVC layer encoding by publishers, per-subscriber bandwidth-based layer selection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, publishers send layered or simulcast video and the service adapts the layer each subscriber receives to their bandwidth

citations.quote: The Media Router supports the scalable video feature. Scalable video can greatly improve the quality of video in multi-party sessions.
The Media Router can decrease bandwidth usage in multiparty sessions.
